name: Mailto UI
description: enhances mailto: links with a small modal UI offering options to open the email in a webmail service or copy the address.
project_description:
A simple way to enhance your mailto links with a convenient user interface.

 MailtoUI is ideal for static sites or any other site where you don't want to spend time setting up a "Contact Us" form solution. Enable MailtoUI module, enable your mailto links, and your users will have a better, more flexible experience interacting with your site.

 Usage 
 After enabling the MailtoUI module in your drupal site, all you need to do is attach the mailto links on the page to MailtoUI. You do that by simply adding the "mailtoui" class to each mailto link.

 <?php

?>

 That's it. Your mailto links are now ready to use MailtoUI.
